# Tree-listbox selection scrolls a label block for trees and the full row for lists

1277 branches on isTree: tree rows scroll their first child so a nested subtree is not included; flat list rows scroll the row itself, which can have no element child. Accepted connectedCallback derives isTree from role and rejects unsupported roles. Current fixtures and Storybook illustrate tree/list roles, but the inspected tree test excerpt does not provide a childless flat-list regression assertion. Preserve both DOM contracts rather than adding a null guard that silently avoids scrolling. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/base/content.
